drafts.title: TPS63001 USB5V to3.3V,650mA continuous allocation
drafts.summary: USB4.75–5.25V input only, fixed3.3V output; author allocation650mA continuous/800mA peak at25C and85% assumed efficiency. Actual TPS63001+LPS4012 and16V X7R bulk caps; unreviewed, not a hardware or battery-boost guarantee.

datasheet.note: TI SLVS520C fixed TPS63001: FB directly to VOUT; 1.2A buck headline at VIN3.6–5.5V supports this derated author allocation of650mA continuous/800mA peak at USB4.75–5.25V only. Not a1.8V boost or all-temperature guarantee. Efficiency85%, output+/-5%, ambient25C and thetaJA60C/W are conservative screening assumptions, not measured performance. Native loops/EP thermal copper, DC-biased effective capacitance and hardware startup/load/temperature require qualification.

Exact LPS4012-222MRC2.2uH+/-20%, DCRmax0.100ohm. At25C: Isat2.3A for10% inductance drop; Irms1.2A for20C rise. Temperature-rise currents are reference values. Buck CCM corner screen uses Lmin1.76uH and fmin1.25MHz, not a boost-current inference. Core loss, switching current and thermal behavior remain unmeasured.

issues.message: Agent/human draft cannot promote itself; independent review is separate
Thermal model is a declared board/ambient assumption, not measured hardware performance

Buck-only screening at4.75–5.25V, Lmin1.76uH, fmin1.25MHz: ripple0.574071A, peak1.087036A. TI1.6A switch-limit minimum is tested at3.6V/25C, not a fullUSB/fulltemperature output guarantee;1.2A buck headline supports derating, not guaranteed hardware performance.

Five actual10uF16V X7R capacitors give20uF input/30uF output nominal. Murata part sheet has no DC-bias curve; tolerance/bias/temperature effective capacitance, ESR and local loops require qualification. No guaranteed effective22uF claim.

650mAcontinuous/800mApeak are declared engineering allocations at25C,85% assumed efficiency, thetaJA60C/W author model (TI reference table46.8C/W). Native DRC, independent schematic review, thermal copper/EP, startup/load-step/EMI and measured efficiency/current/temperature remain separate gates. No battery/1.8V boost guarantee.

notes: Data-only unreviewed candidate; pure ERC/reference/current arithmetic are not native routing or measured hardware acceptance.
Link usb.VBUS -> buck.VBUS, buck.V3V3 -> loads, and shared GND. Qualified USB supply must maintain4.75–5.25V at the board and support aggregate demand.
Existing tps63001-usb-sys-3v3@1 is unchanged; this new variant does not widen any old input domain.
Manufacturer references: TI SLVS520C, complete SLVA358A, Coilcraft LPS4012, retained Murata exact-part sheet. Exact supplier/importer captures and geometry receipts travel with this bundle.
